snippet.title: Into the Haunted Land - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter the Haunted Land with friends. Loot with joy. Escape in TERROR!!

Team up with friends to explore haunted ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters, and escape alive. 
Work together to survive the dangers of the Haunted Land while trying to meet the Guild’s quota.

Wishlist and try Demo On Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917470
